summary: Theme D allows the 4-mark contrasting-beliefs question only on violence, weapons of mass destruction and pacifism. Lesson 1 asked it on forgiveness (a Theme E issue) and lesson 5 on peacemaking. Lesson 1 is reset on violence and lesson 5 on pacifism, each on teaching the lesson already carries. Type label, marks tariff and JSON shape are unchanged; each mark scheme now credits two contrasting beliefs with a reason each.
